{{Current events|year=2022|month=01|day=4|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*A blast hits a vehicle for the Sodicars Racing team as it leaves a hotel in [[Jeddah]], [[Saudi Arabia]], two days prior to the [[Dakar Rally]], critically injuring [[France|French]] driver Philippe Boutron, who is in a medically-induced [[coma]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-59868726 (BBC News)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]], [[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on the arts and cultural heritage]]
**[[Rio de Janeiro]] cancels the 2022 edition of its world-famous [[Rio Carnival|carnival street parade]], which was scheduled to be held from February 25 to March 1, amid the surging COVID-19 cases and the emergence of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant]]. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/rio-de-janeiro-cancels-carnival-street-parade-over-omicron (Radio France Internationale)]

'''Business and economy'''
*The [[Cyberspace Administration of China]] announces that, beginning on February 15, all companies with at least one million users will be required to undergo cybersecurity reviews before they can be listed on foreign [[stock exchanges]]. Companies that are deemed to have an impact on national security will be barred from being listed. [https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2022/1/4/china-to-subject-firms-to-cybersecurity-test-before-foreign-ipos (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Eight people are killed, 14 more are injured and two are missing during flash [[flood]]s in southern [[Iran]], primarily in [[Fars Province]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/1/4/several-killed-in-southern-iran-floods-state-media (Al Jazeera)]
*A search continues for 14 people missing at sea in the [[Solomon Islands]], after their boat failed to reach the [[Shortland Islands]]. Efforts were called off yesterday due to bad weather. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/459030/fourteen-people-are-missing-at-sea-in-solomon-islands (RNZ)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
****[[France]] reports a record 271,686 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours. [https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/france-sees-record-271000-coronavirus-cases-single-day-82072130 (ABC News)]
****[[France]] reports the first discovery of a [[Variants of SARS-CoV-2|new variant]] called the [[SARS-CoV-2_lineage_B.1.640.2|Lineage B.1.640.2 IHU variant]] in 12 patients near [[Marseille]] which contains 46 mutations. [https://www.firstpost.com/health/france-detects-new-covid-19-variant-ihu-more-infectious-than-omicron-all-we-know-about-it-10256521.html (''FirstPost'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Sweden]]
****King [[Carl XVI Gustaf]] and [[Queen Silvia of Sweden]] test positive for COVID-19. [https://thehill.com/policy/international/588166-swedish-king-queen-test-positive-for-covid-19 (''The Hill'')]
****[[Sweden]] reports a record 11,507 new cases of [[COVID-19]] on December 30 due to delayed records of additional cases that were added in the previous days. [https://www.thelocal.se/20220104/sweden-records-highest-number-of-daily-covid-cases-since-start-of-pandemic/ (''The Local Sweden'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Cyprus]]
****[[Cyprus]] reports a record 5,457 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 183,178. [https://cyprus-mail.com/2022/01/04/coronavirus-five-deaths-as-cases-hit-new-record/ (''Cyprus Mail'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Greece]]
****[[Greece]] reports a record 50,126 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 1,344,923. [https://www.ekathimerini.com/news/1174980/greece-sets-new-daily-covid-19-case-record/ (''Ekathimerini'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****[[Italy]] reports a record 170,844 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 6.57 million. [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/italy-reports-record-170844-coronavirus-cases-tuesday-259-deaths-2022-01-04/ (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****The [[United Kingdom]] reports a record 218,724 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, which includes backlog data from [[Northern Ireland]] for the past four days and from [[Wales]] for the past two days. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/health/covid-uk-cases-today-latest-b1986619.html (''The Independent'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China]]
****[[China]] orders 1.1 million people in [[Yuzhou, Henan|Yuzhou]], [[Henan]] to [[stay-at-home order|stay at home]] after three asymptomatic COVID-19 cases were reported. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-59871325 (BBC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hong Kong]]
****[[Chief Executive of Hong Kong|Chief Executive]] [[Carrie Lam]] announces that the "vaccine bubble" will be expanded to restaurants, leisure venues and schools beginning on February 24, which will require people over the age of 12 years to show proof of COVID-19 vaccination of at least one dose in order to enter those venues. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/hong-kong-expand-vaccine-bubble-feb-24-combat-covid-19-spread-2022-01-04/ (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Africa]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mauritania]]
****[[Mauritania]]n [[President of Mauritania|President]] [[Mohamed Ould Ghazouani]] tests positive for COVID-19 and is displaying mild symptoms. [https://www.news24.com/news24/africa/news/mauritanian-president-ghazouani-tests-positive-for-covid-19-20220104 (News 24)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Morocco]]
****[[Morocco]] reports its first confirmed death related to the SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant in an elderly woman who had not received the [[booster dose]] of the [[COVID-19 vaccine]]. [https://www.moroccoworldnews.com/2022/01/346338/morocco-confirms-1st-omicron-death-case (Morocco World News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina]]
***[[Argentina]] reports a record 81,210 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 5.82 million. [https://batimes.com.ar/news/argentina/argentina-hits-new-covid-record-81210-cases-in-24-hours.phtml (''Buenos Aires Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
***[[Australia]] reports a record for the second consecutive day of 47,738 new cases of [[COVID-19]] and surpasses 500,000 cases of COVID-19. [https://www.9news.com.au/national/coronavirus-australia-update-when-will-australia-reach-peak-of-omicron-covid19-cases-new-data-south-africa-shows-case-decrease/b89bbd89-6fa5-4068-ae84-4d1ceb05700c (9 News)] [https://www.sbs.com.au/news/australia-surges-past-covid-19-milestone-of-more-than-500-000-cases-since-pandemic-began/12352d45-0680-439c-8ca7-5336e53a22ee (SBS)] 
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mexico]]
***[[Mexico]] surpasses four million cases of COVID-19. [https://news.trust.org/item/20220105002658-2oz47 (Thomson Reuters Foundation)]

'''International relations'''
*[[North Korea and weapons of mass destruction]]
**The [[South Korea]] [[Joint Chiefs of Staff (South Korea)|Joint Chiefs of Staff]] say that [[North Korea]] has [[List of North Korean missile tests|launched]] an unidentified projectile ballistic missile. No confirmation has been given. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-59876095.amp (BBC News)]
 
'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021–2022 social unrest in the French West Indies]]
**A series of small roadblocks and fires are set up by protesters in the municipality of [[Sainte-Rose, Guadeloupe]]. [https://la1ere.francetvinfo.fr/guadeloupe/conflit-social-barrages-routiers-entre-morne-rouge-et-la-boucan-sainte-rose-ce-mardi-matin-1195753.html (France info)]
*[[2022 Kazakh protests]]
**[[President of Kazakhstan|Kazakh President]] [[Kassym-Jomart Tokayev]] imposes a two-week state of emergency in [[Almaty]], the country's largest city, and in [[Mangystau District]] due to violent protests that have been occurring in the region over an increase in the price of [[gasoline]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/jan/04/kazakhstan-president-declares-state-of-emergency-in-protest-hit-areas (''The Guardian'')]
<!-- All news items above this line -->}}
